text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan's recent success,
particularly in the
Sprinters Stakes, has
resulted in her URA mascot
sales
skyrocketing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Then, one day...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: This is serious, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, becoming a super ultra
mascot will
remain a faraway dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She seems agitated. After calming her
down, I
listen to what she has to say.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I knew it was worth coming to check out
this
store. There's a whole row of
Machan dolls.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: They're very lovely, and very cute!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I know you! I have a doll of you at
home!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Wow, is that right? You have a
wonderful eye for
aesthetics.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm guessing you've seen my races, then?
I'll keep
doing my best, so I hope to see
you at the
racecourse—

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Races? I haven't seen any of those.

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Um... I got your doll 'cause she was cute.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
How eye-opening. It really is darkest
under the
candlestick. Well, that's one
pitfall I didn't
anticipate.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
My mascot dolls really are selling well.
It's
dazzling.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I imagine most people buying them have
seen me
race.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But... it looks like that's not the case
with
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If someone who doesn't know about
Machan sees
one of my mascots, then
it'd just be a mascot to
them.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
We need to do something about that as
soon as
possible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There must be something we can do...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My phone goes off. It's a call from the
editorial
department of a major
publishing company.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
You want to make the four-panel comics
into a
book?!

text_block_list.name: Editor
text_block_list.text:
We do. We were hoping to compile and
publish
the four-panel comics your
trainer has been
making over the past
three years.

text_block_list.name: Editor
text_block_list.text:
Those four-panel comics serve as a full
record of
both your racing endeavors
and your everyday
life.

text_block_list.name: Editor
text_block_list.text:
And most importantly, since the comics
are drawn
from your trainer's
perspective, they're
appropriately
objective, and portray you
adorably!

text_block_list.name: Editor
text_block_list.text:
I'm confident that your newer fans and
long-time
supporters alike will all be
delighted to read the
finished product.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hm, I see. This is all very intriguing!

text_block_list.name: Editor
text_block_list.text:
I hear that it's your lifelong dream to
achieve
widespread sales as an official
URA mascot.

text_block_list.name: Editor
text_block_list.text:
I believe this book will ultimately
contribute to
those sales.

text_block_list.name: Editor
text_block_list.text:
For example, some people have never
seen you
race, but they know about you
and your races
through the comics.

text_block_list.name: Editor
text_block_list.text:
I think that kind of person would take an
interest
in your mascot dolls.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Aston Machan's ears perk up.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So, you're saying that even people who
have
never seen me race would still be
interested in
Machan dolls?

text_block_list.name: Editor
text_block_list.text: Yes, exactly!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
They'd stop seeing them as generic
mascots and
start seeing them as Aston
Machan mascots.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Even more people would remember me,
and more
vividly. In other words...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'd be taking a step towards becoming a
super
ultra mascot.

text_block_list.name: Editor
text_block_list.text: ...You could definitely say that!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Let's do it, Trainer. This is a
once-in-a-lifetime
opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From that point on, the publishing talks
proceed
at a rapid pace...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And before we know it, the publishing
date for
the comic compilation is set for
the very near
future!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Trainer... what's your favorite food?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's about the publishing. I've been
thinking.
choice_data_list: What happened all of a sudden?
What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If it wasn't for you, those four-panel
comics
wouldn't exist.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Even if I'd thought to draw them myself,
they
would've all been from my
perspective, so they
wouldn't have been
lovely.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
You're the only one who could've drawn
them,
and you've kept on putting in the
effort.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: So... I want to know your favorite food.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm guessing she's trying to show her
appreciation
somehow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's because Aston Machan works so hard
that I
wanted to do something to help
her...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her running is so wonderful that I felt
the need to
share it with everyone.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so?
choice_data_list: You're the one who made me want to tell them.
You made me want to tell you

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"People love merchandise with a story
behind it."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The movie might have failed, but I have
a feeling
this will work out.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
People who knew me, and people who
didn't...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I think they'll love me, and they'll keep
on loving
me into the distant future.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: And... what was your favorite food?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Well, if you don't want to tell me, that's
okay.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'll get us some cake on the way back.
Let's eat it
together.
